handling_unit_guardrails: Classic JIT supports CRHU and DEHU for stock-transfer HU handling, DELI/JITK for automatic HU generation during delivery creation, VL10HU for retrospective HU assignment in summarized JIT, and HUPP for a deliverable HU.

In current Next Generation JIT documentation, action-control or other JIT-specific checks are not performed while deleting a handling unit. A recovery design must therefore validate JIT state explicitly.
For nested HUs, individual levels cannot be deleted; the complete HU must be deleted.
Unassigning or deleting an HU from an outbound delivery is allowed only together with cancellation of the outbound delivery, not as an independent step.

A documented background scheduling option for HU creation for sequenced JIT calls is marked deprecated in current documentation; do not build a new design around it without release-specific validation.

agent_rules: Do not call a transaction or program standard unless it is listed here or verified in the target release.
Do not infer that status correction reverses business documents.
For scanner or MES design, prefer supported JIT action interfaces instead of direct database/status updates.
Before HU deletion or unassignment, inspect outbound delivery and warehouse state.
Treat a generic multi-document cancellation report as project-specific unless the target system contains a verified standard or customer solution.
